To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Group Storytelling technique is a useful tool to elicit stories from the organization and to design training content, and that this content, when implemented, can be a valuable tool to train professionals.
the Group Storytelling technique is an effective way for training content design, because the stories are real and told by professionals, and they can reproduce the organizations´ real processes.
the use of stories in the training process, in the context of the organization, is a way to improve the learning of the employees.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a method to design training content, based on Group Storytelling, which allows to capture the experiences of professionals in a way that they can be used in the training process.
the design of training content based on group storytelling, in the context of the Brazilian Army, in order to promote learning and the transfer of knowledge within the organization.
the development of a methodology to design training content through group storytelling.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the Group Storytelling methodology, as a tool for the training design, is capable to provide the organization with the opportunity to learn from its own experiences, to share knowledge and to improve its performance.

, through the Group Storytelling, it is possible to develop training content that is aligned with the organizations real needs, which promotes the development of organizational learning and which is capable to reproduce real situations.
the training is an important attainment to the organizations’ continued existence.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the stories are a powerful tool to capture, share and transmit knowledge, and to promote organizational learning, which is a fundamental aspect for the organizations´ survival.
the stories are a powerful instrument of learning and communication.
the stories told by professionals are a source to develop training content.
The main takeaway from our work is that
storytelling can be used as a method to design training content, and that the use of this method in the design of training content has a positive effect on the training.
the use of stories as training content is effective to improve the learning of concepts, and to increase the motivation of the participants.
storytelling is an effective way of learning.
